question: What three major disciplines combine to form nursing informatics?

options.B: Medicine, statistics, and public health administration
options.C: Nursing science, computer science, and information science
options.D: Nursing theory, hospital management, and engineering

explanation: Nursing informatics is an integration of nursing science along with computer and information sciences to manage healthcare data. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: The primary goal of nursing informatics in a healthcare facility is to achieve what outcome?

options.A: Completely eliminate paper records within twenty-four hours
options.B: Improve patient outcomes by managing health data effectively
options.C: Lower the cost of medical equipment purchased by the ward
options.D: Reduce the total number of employed registered nurses

explanation: Proper management of health information and technology supports clinical decision-making and enhances the quality of patient care. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: An automated computer alert warning a nurse about a patient drug allergy is an example of what system?
explanation: Clinical decision support tools use patient data to provide timely prompts and alerts that guide safe nursing practice. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: A nurse in a rural Nigerian clinic uses a mobile application to consult a specialist in a city hospital. What informatics subfield does this represent?
explanation: Using tele-health and digital communication tools directly for patient care delivery falls under clinical nursing informatics. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: Nurse managers primarily use administrative informatics tools for what purpose?

options.A: Writing individual nursing care plans for bedside patients
options.B: Conducting laboratory tests on patient blood samples
options.C: Teaching clinical procedures to newly employed nursing students
options.D: Managing staff schedules, budgets, and operational workflows

explanation: Administrative informatics helps leaders handle operational tasks like staffing, budgeting, and workflow evaluation. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: Why are visual data dashboards valuable for a hospital nursing director?

options.A: They prevent hospital equipment from ever breaking down unexpectedly
options.B: They automatically dispense medications to patients without human checks
options.C: They turn complex staffing and patient numbers into clear trends for decision-making
options.D: They replace the need for direct communication between nurses and doctors

explanation: Dashboards aggregate large amounts of operational data into visible metrics, helping leaders make fast, evidence-based choices. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: What is the primary function of a Learning Management System in nursing education?

options.A: Calculating hospital staff salaries and tax deductions
options.B: Distributing course materials, managing assignments, and hosting virtual classes
options.C: Monitoring patient vital signs inside an intensive care unit
options.D: Storing government public health statistics and census data

explanation: Learning Management Systems provide a centralized digital platform for educators to deliver course content and interact with students. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: How do clinical simulation softwares benefit student nurses before they enter hospital wards?

options.A: They allow students to practice decision-making safely on digital patient scenarios
options.B: They guarantee that students will never make a mistake during clinical postings
options.C: They grade student examinations without any input from nursing lecturers
options.D: On-screen training completely replaces the need for hands-on hospital experience

explanation: Simulations give students risk-free opportunities to apply critical thinking and clinical skills before encountering real patients. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: What is the main role of research informatics in the nursing profession?

options.A: Handling patient complaints regarding hospital billing errors
options.B: Managing and analyzing data to generate evidence for clinical practice
options.C: Scheduling clinical postings for undergraduate nursing students
options.D: Ordering routine medical supplies for hospital wards and clinics

explanation: Research informatics focuses on collecting, organizing, and analyzing data to build scientific evidence for nursing interventions. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: Why is the use of standardized clinical terminology important in nursing research?

options.A: It ensures that patients can read and understand complex scientific journals
options.B: It reduces the amount of time required to complete a university degree
options.C: It allows research data to be shared and compared accurately across different institutions
options.D: It stops nurses from using paper charts during community health outreaches

explanation: Standardized terms ensure uniform data collection, making it easier to combine and analyze research findings globally. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: Who is the primary user or focus of consumer health informatics?

options.D: The patient and the general public

explanation: Consumer health informatics centers on providing tools and information directly to patients and the community. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)

question: A patient uses a smartphone application to monitor blood glucose levels and share reports with a nurse. This illustrates which informatics type?
explanation: Patient-managed mobile health apps and self-monitoring tools fall squarely under consumer health informatics. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)

question: What is a major challenge facing the adoption of nursing informatics in many Nigerian healthcare settings?

options.A: Federal laws making electronic documentation illegal
options.B: A complete lack of interest from Nigerian patients
options.C: Inconsistent electricity and poor internet infrastructure
options.D: The absence of any sick patients needing digital care

explanation: Infrastructure hurdles like unstable power and limited internet access slow down the full deployment of digital health tools in Nigeria. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h7)

question: Which of the following is NOT a common goal of integrating informatics into Nigerian healthcare?

options.A: Increasing the amount of physical paper records stored in wards
options.B: Enhancing patient safety through digital medication alerts
options.C: Facilitating communication between urban and rural clinics
options.D: Improving the speed and accuracy of patient documentation

explanation: Informatics aims to reduce dependence on physical paper records by shifting toward efficient electronic health systems. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h7)
